# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly 14 to 15 years old  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P55](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0055)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried; hired servant  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>
- **Role:** Hired domestic servant  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P55](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda the Fourth is a small, energetic girl with a wide mouth and freckles covering her face. She has long, fair braids tied with large blue ribbon bows.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038)_

## Personality

She is cheerful, loyal, and devoted to her mistress, though easily flustered and prone to imagining dramatic or disastrous outcomes. Hardworking and practical, she takes pride in her service and gets deeply invested in the lives and romances of those around her.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P11](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0011), [v1 c19 P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)_

## Traits

- Cheerful and energetic  <sub>[v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087)</sub>
- Devoted and loyal to Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)</sub>
- Prone to dramatic worry and panic  <sub>[v1 c19 P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052)</sub>
- Hardworking and practical  <sub>[v1 c19 P11](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0011), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>
- Distrustful of men  <sub>[v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052)</sub>

## Abilities

- Housekeeping and domestic chores  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c19 P43](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0043)</sub>
- Blowing a tin horn to produce echoes  <sub>[v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P71](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0071)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve Miss Rosalind faithfully and remain with her  <sub>[v1 c19 P55](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0055), [v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)</sub>

## History

Belinda the Fourth came to work as a domestic servant for Miss Rosalind Penrose at Echo Cottage at the age of thirteen. She managed the household chores and proved to be the most capable and well-liked of her sisters. When Nell Harcourt visited Echo Cottage to confess that she was responsible for jumping on Miss Rosalind's spare-room bed, Belinda ushered her into the parlor. Later, when Miss Rosalind threatened to leave for the city over the incident, she relented partly because she was entertained by Nell and wished to stay. When Stephen Stanhope returned to woo Miss Rosalind, Belinda helped keep the visit secret and eagerly observed the courtship. After Miss Rosalind accepted Stephen's proposal, Belinda was overjoyed to learn she would accompany her mistress to reside in Boston once she turned sixteen.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P38](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0038), [v1 c19 P55](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0055), [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual name is Leonora, but she is called 'Belinda the Fourth' because she is the fourth sister in the Bowman family hired to serve Miss Rosalind Penrose  <sub>[v1 c19 P55](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0055)</sub>
- Entered Miss Rosalind's service at age thirteen in exchange for room, board, and clothes  <sub>[v1 c19 P55](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0055)</sub>

## Quotes

> Oh, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, what does that mean in plain language?  <sub>[v1 c19 P50](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0050)</sub>

> There is nothing I can do, and remaining here merely waiting is terrible. What if he fails to propose in the end, Miss Harcourt, ma’am? One can never feel certain about those men.  <sub>[v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052)</sub>

> I’ve been dreadfully anxious, pondering whatever would become of her once I grew so large that I must depart for Boston.  <sub>[v1 c19 P55](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0055)</sub>

> Oh, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, his arm is wrapped around her waist. She wouldn't ever permit it unless he has proposed to her.  <sub>[v1 c19 P71](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0071)</sub>


## Affiliations

- Echo Cottage Household — Hired servant  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c19 P55](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0055)</sub>
